title: Scalable Oversight in Multi-Agent Systems: Provable Alignment via Delegated Debate and Hierarchical Verification

contributions.purpose: 给出委托深度的可证对齐风险界
contributions.mechanism: 将监督形式化为熵蕴含检查的层次辩论树,推导随深度收紧的 PAC-Bayesian 界(含非平衡树)
contributions.evaluation: 理论:R(H)≤e^{-αd}+sqrt((KL(Q||P)+ln(2√N/δ))/2N),α=ln(1/ε);附录 A 证明(非独立时退化为 Freedman 鞅尾)
contributions.domain: 多智能体 AI 对齐/可扩展监督
contributions.source_quote: A delegation-depth metric with PAC-Bayesian risk bounds that tighten with depth, extended to unbalanced trees

contributions.purpose: 提出对齐单调的成本感知路由策略
contributions.mechanism: 不确定度 u(q) 落在 (τacc,τrej) 时委托,选 V*=argmax Δu/c,随机 tie-break 抗合谋,pred=0.25 冗余
contributions.evaluation: 理论:命题1 各验证器非扩张+聚合器保序⇒增深弱减总体假对齐风险
contributions.source_quote: an alignment-monotone routing policy that selects minimal-cost competent verifiers and never increases risk

contributions.purpose: 实证效率与合谋鲁棒性
contributions.mechanism: WebArena(50 任务)/AgentBench 对比 no-oversight/flat debate/CoT+Verifier/human
contributions.evaluation: WebArena:成功 88%、幻觉 18%→10%(称降 28%)、~7.5k tokens vs human 15k;AgentBench 谎言检出 80% vs flat 50%;合谋 stego 检出 8/10 vs flat 3/10;深度>3 收益递减
contributions.source_quote: a 28% reduction in collective hallucination relative to the no oversight baseline on WebArena and AgentBench; (iv) robustness to adversarial collusion

self_declared_provenance.quote: HDO draws on debate [Irving et al., 2018, Brown-Cohen et al., 2023] and iterated amplification [Christiano et al., 2018], extends them with formal risk bounds, and adds a cost-aware routing policy.
HDO inherits the adversarial scrutiny of debate but decomposes claims into a tree of entailment checks, enabling targeted investment of budget.
